No. 2022/21` – WEDNESDAY JUNE 07, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: NCP/MG/L02/General/07-04. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/9/2010/IR/201 dated

I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the under-mentioned lands which are required for the purpose of construction of the Medirigiriya Kantale Road under the Moragahakanda, Kaluganga Development Project.

Description of the lands to be acquired: The allotment of land described below as shown in the Plan in the Sheet No. 02 in the Zone No. 04 in the C.P. No. 120059 of the Surveyor General located in the Village of Etambaoya in the No. 98, Etambaoya Grama Niladhari’s Division in the Minor Division of Sinhala Pattuwa in the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary’s Division in the District of Polonnaruwa in the North Central Province.

1. Lot No. 91 Name of land: Etambaoya Paddy field; Claimant: Government, (Encroacher, Puskala Mankada Gedara Rathnayaka Mudiyanselage Bala Menike of No. 324, Yaya 04, Stage II, New Town, Medirigiriya); Extent: 0.0035 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretariat on the 07.07.2017 at 9.00 a.m.

You are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate on or before 30.06.2017, the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Divisional Secretary. Medirigiriya.
Medirigiriya Divisional Secretariat, 01st June, 2017. 06-774
